authorization: 2026-10-23 user: both Kimi and GLM30 tasks, run in parallel, recover interrupted work.
purpose: Exploratory historical matched comparison; no presupposed negligible harness effect.
execution_order: Within each10-task cohort, clarified then direct then interact; task order from frozen sample, backends pandas/polars/ibis/pyspark. GLM original10 recovery completes before its added20.
budgets: Per-cell historical effective generation budget; GLM1800s, Kimi600/1800s. Evaluation120s.
failure_policy: Completed/scored failures and model timeouts retained; never auto-retry. Technical or unknown failed-agent results pause for inspection. Incomplete folders never overwritten. Old PATENTS/Ibis attempt3 separately authorized and audited in old root.
reuse: GLM original120 cells remain in old root; effective original+technical replacement evidence linked, not replayed. No historical OpenCode reruns.
isolation: Frozen generate.py exposes data/query/public description and clarified hints only; evaluator and GT never mounted for generation. Interact simulator has private hints. Separate model profiles/temp/run roots and fresh agent session percell.
analysis: Report all720 planned cells with failures/missing. Paired summaries by model/mode/backend, clustered by30 tasks; no outcome-selected exclusions. Route/budget/chronology limitations separately reported.
limitations: Historical OpenCode and current Codex not contemporaneous; provider model revision may differ.
Responses versus ChatCompletions, provider routing and account may differ; provider-provenance addendum controls evidence levels.
Historical raw inputs checked by size/mtime only; new byte hashes do not reconstruct historical byte proof.
Concurrent PrepBench and model runs affectwalltime; snapshots retained.
30tasks and12 correlated cells/task do not establish statistical equivalence.
